_context.description: Sher Wagyu beef is marketed as Sher Black in Japan, as Japanese regulations restrict the use of the word Wagyu to beef produced in Japan. Cattle are pasture fed until 18 months of age, then grain fed for 400 days to create a delicious and consistent Wagyu product for you to enjoy. Sher Wagyu is the ultimate eating experience. Delicious, tender & juicy with a superb flavour. Here at PRIME we would like you to experience the best of Sher Wagyu beef double black label MS9+. An exclusive Wagyu experience for the truly discerning diner.
